definitions: An ongoing economic trend in which large numbers of people have voluntarily left their jobs since 2021.
A period of high employee turnover, particularly in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic, driven by factors such as burnout, desire for better work-life balance, and reevaluation of career priorities.
examples: The Great Resignation impacted many industries.
Companies struggled to retain staff during the Great Resignation.
Remote work became more popular during the Great Resignation.
